svg.text: End-view schematic, Y horizontal / Z up. Connector mounting PNs are not frozen.
Body mating plane X65.7; tool receiver front X76.7. D18 pilot + off-centre D3 pin.
PWR: supply only. CTRL: CAN or separate RJ45/EtherCAT insert; different electrical contract.
CAM_UP and CAM_DOWN: independent coax channels. PoC is conditional on actual camera chain.
Unplug budget +X 25 mm. Remove lid +Z; panel slides out +Z. Each channel has tie slots.
Amber apertures/blocks are space allocations, not qualified vendor mounts or pinouts.
No hollow RS00, live power, hotplug or dynamic bend qualification is assumed.
Exact current part features and clocking are in STEP and interface.json. Supported trial only.
